top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received personnel policies (26 TAC §744.901(6)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 of 3 staff files reviewed did not include a signed and dated statement that employee received personnel policies.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Orientation (26 TAC §744.1301(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three employees did not have a statement stating that they had received orientation.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §744.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver lacked a notarized affidavit - Form 2985 -  in their documentation.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received operational policies (26 TAC §744.901(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 of 3 staff files reviewed did not include a signed and dated statement that employee received operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Each caregiver, operation director, program director, and site director Training in Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing and Choking. (26 TAC §744.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregivers did not have their CPR and First Aid certificates available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §747.2705(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence of Corporal Punishment was observed from video footage obtained from the operation cameras.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §747.605(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's record lacked the name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or an emergency-care facility

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.
